name: OpenSpeedTest
description: An application for launching HTML5 Network Speed Test Server. You can test download & upload speed from any device within your network with a web browser that is IE10 or new.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  openspeedtest:
    image: openspeedtest/latest:v2.0.6
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: always
    container_name: openspeedtest
